name: better-product-graph
description: Turns product signals into evidence-bound decisions, plans, versioned PRDs, and local engineering handoffs through one governed Codex Skill.

interface.longDescription: A local-first product workflow that preserves source evidence, helps a PM reach an explicit product decision, plans outcome-oriented increments, produces versioned PRDs, and prepares exact local handoffs. Semantic product work is performed by the Host Agent under versioned instructions; deterministic local code enforces state, permissions, validation, versions, recovery, and release identity.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this product signal and help me decide what to do next.
Resume my current Better Product Graph run.
Show the exact local handoff for this run.
